content: Vision agents stall in screenshot-action loops: browser-use issues document agents repeating the same step infinitely (#1157), max_failures-per-step flags not working (#3576), and multi-step task chains breaking. Computer-use docs (Meta/OpenAI) prescribe max step counts, and frameworks ship loop/repetition detection. Mitigations: hard step ceilings, repeated-action detection on action history, per-step timeouts, stuck-state detection that escalates rather than retries.
